name: lms-assignment
description: Loan Management System — Next.js + Express + MongoDB

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
